idea-plugin.name: EmmyLua Enhanced
idea-plugin.description:
Lua language support and debugging for IntelliJ-based IDEs, tuned for Unreal Engine (UnLua) projects. A fork of EmmyLua whose language features are powered by the official EmmyLua language server (emmylua_ls) and whose debugger was rewritten for attaching to running games and for AI agents.

Language support

  • Completion, go to definition / implementation, find usages, rename, hover docs, parameter and inlay hints, diagnostics with quick fixes, formatting, semantic highlighting, folding, workspace symbols and call hierarchy, provided by emmylua_ls through LSP4IJ. No Lua index is built inside the IDE, so large projects stay fast.
  • EmmyLua / LuaLS annotations: generics, ---@enum, ---@overload and more, behaving the same as EmmyLua in VS Code and Neovim. Configure with .emmyrc.json or .luarc.json.
  • emmylua_ls binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux (x64 / arm64) are bundled; nothing else to install.
  • Comment translation: English comments in hover docs are translated in the background (bilingual or translation only), and "Translate Selection" translates the selected text or the comment at the caret, using free services (Google / Microsoft / MyMemory, no key needed) with a local cache.
  • Editor helpers: auto-inserted end / until, Surround With, postfix templates, "Generate function annotation", live templates, Lua-aware spell checking.
  • Unreal Engine / UnLua: finds the .uproject and adds UnLua IntelliSense or UELink-generated declarations as libraries automatically.

Debugging

  • Attach to a running local process (Windows) without changing game code.
  • Attach to a game on an Android device over adb; nothing is added to the package.
  • Conditional, hit-count and log breakpoints, probes that record values without stopping, break on Lua errors, coroutine stacks, editable variables, debug console.
  • Sampling Lua profiler with flame graph export.
  • One-key hot reload of Lua into a running Unreal Editor or game through UELink.
  • MCP tools on the IDE's built-in MCP server (2025.2+): AI agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can set breakpoints, step, inspect stacks and variables, and search Lua code.

Note: this plugin registers the same Lua language as the original EmmyLua plugin, so the two cannot be enabled together; the IDE offers to disable the other one on install. Requires LSP4IJ, which the IDE installs on request. Source and issues: GitHub.

基于 EmmyLua 的 Lua 插件，面向 UE（UnLua）项目：

  • 语言支持基于 EmmyLua 官方语言服务器 emmylua_ls（经 LSP4IJ）：补全、跳转、查找引用、重命名、悬停、诊断、格式化、语义高亮
  • 注释翻译：悬停文档里的注释后台翻译（双语对照），右键「翻译选中内容」
  • UE / UnLua：自动加入 UnLua IntelliSense 或 UELink 后台生成的声明
  • Lua 调试：附加本机进程（Windows）、Android 真机附加（包体零改动）、条件 / 日志断点、Probe、采样性能分析、经 UELink 热重载
  • 给 AI Agent 用的 MCP 调试和代码查找工具（注册到 IDE 自带的 MCP 服务器）
  • 和上游 EmmyLua 插件不能同时启用
